item.title: Meet Zootopia's star-studded mayor
item.description: From Kronk in "The Emperor's New Groove" to Pulaski from "Planes: Fire & Rescue", voice actor Patrick Warburton's unmistakable voice can be heard in several of Disney's classic films.

item.title: East Bay animation studio makes its dream come true
item.description: As a student at NYU's Tisch School of the Arts, writer and director Alex Woo's goal was to make an animated feature film.

item.title: 'The Flipper Room' brings classic pinball fun to East Bay
item.description: Come for the custom framing, stay for a few rounds of pinball. Here's how "The Flipper Room" is bringing classic pinball fun to the East Bay.

item.title: Bay Area celebrates New Year's Eve with preparations for SF's fireworks show underway
item.description: Preparations continued on Wednesday for the big fireworks show on the Embarcadero in San Francisco. Meanwhile, other parts of the Bay Area started festivities early.

item.title: LIVE: New Year's Eve in Times Square, New York City | Countdown to 2026
item.description: Watch as thousands gather in Times Square for the dropping of the New Year's Eve ball at midnight to ring in 2026!

item.title: AccuWeather Forecast: Light to moderate rain continues into New Year
item.description: We have had steady light-to-moderate showers across the Bay Area for most of the day, and the showers will persist through the midnight hour. Roads are wet and slippery, and viewing conditions for tonight's fireworks will be far from ideal.

item.title: Prominent California farmer pleads not guilty to fatally shooting estranged wife at her Arizona home
item.description: A prominent California farmer has pleaded not guilty to a murder charge in the shooting death of his estranged wife at her home in Arizona.

item.title: Trump announces National Guard to be removed from Los Angeles, Chicago and Portland
item.description: President Donald Trump said he's dropping - for now - his push to deploy National Guard troops in Chicago, Los Angeles and Portland, Oregon, a move that comes after legal roadblocks hung up the effort.

item.title: Body found confirmed to be missing 19-year-old Camila Mendoza Olmos, death ruled suicide
item.description: The body that was found in a Texas field has been identified as Camila Mendoza Olmos, a 19-year-old who had been missing since Christmas Eve, authorities confirmed Wednesday.

item.description: The new year means new toll prices on most Bay Area bridges. Here are the ones affected starting Jan. 1.
